researcher_notes: Sources swept: ExaSearch/ExaContents for Texas Lawyer (law.com), Texas Lawbook, Law360 Pulse, Houston Business Journal, BusinessWire/EINPresswire/PRNewswire firm-launch and lateral-hire releases (2024-2026); direct raw-HTML pulls (curl/python, no browser) of ~45 Houston boutique firm websites for attorney bios, contact pages, careers pages and news indexes; and the State Bar of Texas 'Find a Lawyer' member directory (POST to /CustomSource/MemberDirectory/Result_form_client.cfm) to independently confirm each decision-maker's name, firm affiliation, primary practice address and published telephone. Every candidate below has (a) the firm's own attorney-bio page and (b) either a State Bar profile or an independent press item as the second source. IMPORTANT CAVEAT FOR THE VERIFIER: the State Bar directory confirms NAME + FIRM + ADDRESS + PHONE but does NOT publish job titles. Where the second title source is a bar profile rather than a press item or LinkedIn, the title itself rests on the firm's own bio page only; I have flagged each such row in 'notes'. Rows where the title is independently corroborated by press (Beck Redden/David Beck, Mo Lovett, Greenberg Streich, Vasquez Waite, Heim Payne/Michael Heim, Burke Law Group/Marcella Burke, Wright Close Barger & Guzman) or by LinkedIn (Ford + Bergner, Reddy Neumann Brown, Oliva Gibbs, BoyarMiller) are noted as such. What was thin: (1) LinkedIn profile URLs -- Exa's LinkedIn coverage returned a usable /in/ URL for only 4 of 30 decision-makers, so linkedin_url is null for most rows rather than guessed; (2) direct partner emails -- several Houston litigation boutiques (Hicks Thomas, Burke Law Group, Williams Hart & Boundas, Wright Abshire, Fullenweider Wilhite, Vasquez Waite, Greenberg Streich, Heim Payne) publish no named mailbox, so contact_email is null and company_email carries the info@/general@ address; (3) the HBJ 'Largest Houston Law Firms' list is fully paywalled ($152 download) so I could not use list rank as a trigger for individual firms -- I used HBJ Best Places to Work honors instead where firms self-announced them; (4) attorney headcounts are counts of attorney-bio links on each firm's own attorney index page (the URL is given in employee_count_source) and are null where I did not count them -- none are estimated. Where no dated 2024-2026 trigger exists I used trigger_signal 'other' and said so plainly in trigger_detail. Two Yetter Coleman addresses exist in the wild (600 Travis St Ste 5400 on the firm's current contact page vs 811 Main St Ste 4100 in the bar directory); I recorded the firm's own current page and flagged the conflict. Final counts: 30 candidates, 21 rejected; 22 candidates carry a named partner contact_email, all 30 carry a published phone, 20 carry a dated trigger, 4 carry a LinkedIn URL. Trigger mix: 10 leadership_expansion, 5 new_launch, 2 growth_list, 1 hiring_ea, 12 'other' (no dated 2024-2026 event found -- each says so in trigger_detail). Bella Law PLLC and Roberts Markel Weinberg Butler Hailey were drafted as candidates and then moved to 'rejected' on solopreneur-risk and >150-staff-risk respectively; both are re-workable if another agent verifies headcount.
